subject.title: fix: Windows /restart falls back to in-process restart without changing PID

question: Should an env-less manually started Windows gateway be allowed to use an installed Scheduled Task as its `/restart` supervisor path?
rationale: This changes a compatibility-sensitive fallback from same-process restart to supervised exit, so maintainers need to confirm the Windows restart contract and proof bar before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Support Scheduled Task probing
options.body: Land the linked PR after it probes the exact default/profile/custom task target and includes Windows `/restart` plus `/status` proof.

options.title: Keep env-marker-only detection
options.body: Keep the current in-process fallback unless the gateway was launched with trusted service markers, accepting that this report remains unfixed.

options.title: Split broader restart redesign
options.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers define a larger Windows restart recovery contract covering env-less tasks, fallback launchers, and status truth reconciliation.

recommendation.title: Support Scheduled Task probing
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after it probes the exact default/profile/custom task target and includes Windows `/restart` plus `/status` proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently authored and merged adjacent Windows restart handoff work and are the best available routing candidate for the current Windows restart contract choice.
